title: RPP-5d TABLESTYLE typed DXF row-style projection fast slice

fields.description: The following group codes are repeated for every cell

changes: Added typed DXF projection for TABLESTYLE row text-style name, height, alignment, indexed text/fill color, CMC RGB/name/book metadata, background state, paired data/unit types, and six border families.
Kept the complete ordered raw TABLESTYLE carrier so unsupported fields and original ASCII numeric spellings remain available for lossless replay.

Generated ASCII/Binary controls verify three distinct typed rows, raw group/value order, and that an incomplete row is not published as typed while a following valid TABLESTYLE sentinel is published in order.
Corrected the order assertion to compare decimal handles returned by its wire helper; the earlier hexadecimal lookup caused a false test failure.
